newsitem.title: UK: MGAM says not publishing fund redemptions.
newsitem.headline: MGAM says not publishing fund redemptions.

text.p: Morgan Grenfell Asset Management (MGAM) said on Wednesday it was no longer going to give redemption levels in the three funds currently under investigation because of suspected irregularities.

A spokesman for Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, the investment banking arm of Deutsche Bank, said the decision not to publish the redemptions, which it has done since the funds resumed trading last Thursday, followed support from Deutsche.

"After today's announcement that Deutsche has committed to buying units, investors can be assured that liquidity in the funds is assured and therefore we will not be publishing redemptions," DMG's James Murray told Reuters.

There had been concerns that an initial 300 million stg in the funds, boosted by a 180 million stg cash injection by Deutsche Bank last week, would run out after investor redemptions reached 256 million stg late on Tuesday.

But MGAM said earlier on Wednesday that the rate of redemptions had slowed down significantly and "there is currently sufficient liquidity in each of the three investment funds to meet redemption demands".
